osm_report.threat_description:
VS Code autorun dropper. Payload in .vscode/tasks.json.
Outbound: fetch-and-run. It downloads code from jerryfox-platform.vercel.app and executes it (.vscode/tasks.json).
Runs automatically when the folder is opened in VS Code (hidden folderOpen task that fetches and runs a remote script).
Matches PolinRider / Contagious Interview (DPRK): fake-recruiter coding tasks that run a downloader when opened in VS Code. Payload host: jerryfox-platform.vercel.app.
Campaign GW-C-a3717cc8: one of 20 confirmed repos across 17 accounts sharing the dropper URL shape task/{os}?token=. Payload served from 10 distinct hosts, including codeviewer-three.vercel.app, coreviewer.vercel.app, jerryfox-platform.vercel.app, task-hrec.vercel.app, thopywork.vercel.app.
Attribution: the tradecraft is consistent with North Korea, but a single signal is a lead rather than an attribution, so we do not attribute it on this evidence alone. Signals: Delivery vector matches Contagious-Interview tradecraft: vscode-folderopen-autorun.
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: task/mac?token=; task/linux?token=; task/windows?token=.
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
